reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.intro: Email, Telegram, or ManyChat messages for registered attendees. The first message goes out right after registration. Later messages follow the scheduled start.
reminders.clockBroadcast: The message after the start is sent when the video broadcast begins. Messages after the webinar are sent when the broadcast stops.
reminders.clockDuration: Messages after the start and after the end use the duration. If there is no duration, the message after the end is counted from the start.
reminders.languageNote: Message language is the language of the letters. The screen language does not change it. Hand-edited text stays, and standard text is rewritten.
reminders.needSchedule: Set the webinar start and save first. Then the system can calculate when to send.
reminders.needDuration: Duration is missing, so messages after the end are counted from the start. Enter a duration and save the webinar.
reminders.noEmail: There is no active Brevo, Resend, or SMTP integration. Connect one on the Integrations page first.
reminders.noTelegram: There is no active Telegram bot. Connect a BotFather token on the Integrations page first.
reminders.noManychat: There is no active ManyChat integration. Add the API key and link template on the Integrations page first.
reminders.subject: Email subject
reminders.empty: No reminders yet. The standard sequence starts with a message right after registration, then 1 day, 1 hour, and 15 minutes before the start, 5 minutes after the start, and messages for people who attended and people who missed it.
reminders.errorOffset: Choose a sending integration and enter a time in minutes (0 or more).
reminders.errorConnect: Connect an email or Telegram integration on the Integrations page first.
reminders.alreadyCreated: The standard reminders are already created.
